dialogue.speaker: Old Keeper
dialogue.text: Halt, traveler. You have the look of someone seeking the deep dark.

dialogue.speaker: Old Keeper
dialogue.text: I was a Lightkeeper once... before the relays failed and the shadows crept in.

dialogue.speaker: Old Keeper
dialogue.text: The creatures down there feed on broken light. They'll take everything from you if you let them.

dialogue.speaker: Old Keeper
dialogue.text: A word of advice: never carry more than you can afford to lose. Death has a price in these crypts.

dialogue.speaker: Old Keeper
dialogue.text: Now go. The stairs await, and the dark won't keep itself at bay.

has_key.speaker: Old Keeper
has_key.text: You found the iron key? Good. The locked door to the east should yield to it.

has_key.speaker: Old Keeper
has_key.text: Be careful what lies beyond. Not all doors are meant to be opened.

explored_crypt_02.speaker: Old Keeper
explored_crypt_02.text: You've seen the Bone Chamber and returned alive. That's more than most can say.

explored_crypt_02.speaker: Old Keeper
explored_crypt_02.text: The deeper you go, the darker it gets. But you already knew that.

dialogue.speaker: Apprentice Sol Engineer
dialogue.text: You must be here to pickup the old Sol Unit. The repairs are almost complete.
